institution.name: Instituto de Ciências Matemáticas e de Computação (ICMC), Universidade de São Paulo

qualifications: Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or related areas, conferred by the enrolment date
Selection by academic transcript and Lattes CV; the doctorate also requires a research proposal
Registration is free, via the master's and doctoral forms on the programme site
Second doctoral flow: registration 5 January - 4 February 2027
description_short: ICMC-USP in São Carlos is selecting master's and doctoral students in computer science and computational mathematics (PPG-CCMC) for 2027. Registration is free; master's and first-flow doctoral applications close 5 November 2026, with a second doctoral flow in January-February 2027.
